summary.tldr: Elects the Senate Speaker and Deputy Speaker by secret ballot, changes when they can vote, and updates Senate rules and pay.
what_it_does: Requires the Senate to elect a Speaker and a Deputy Speaker by secret ballot after a general election, and to fill any vacancy the same way.
Changes Senate voting rules so the senator presiding votes only when voices are tied.
Lets the Deputy Speaker take the chair when the Speaker leaves during a sitting, and lets another senator take over if the Deputy Speaker must leave.
Keeps Senate decisions valid when they are made by the Deputy Speaker or by another senator acting in the Speaker’s place.
Sets the annual salary for the Deputy Speaker of the Senate at $20,600.
summary.background: Under current law, the Governor General appoints the Speaker of the Senate. The bill would replace that with elected Senate officers and add a Deputy Speaker role.
